yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t zp = (z < nz - 1) ? z + 1 : z;\n    const size_t zn = (z > 0) ? z - 1 : 0;\n    return {base + idx3(0, y, * dx, dy2 = dy * dy, dz2 = dz * dz;\n    #pragma omp for collapse(2) schedule(static)\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            const RowPtrs p = rowPtrs(c, y, z, nx, ny, nz);\n            double* __restrict m = mu + idx3(0, y, z, nx, ny);\n            auto point = [&](const size_t x, const size_t xp, const size_t xn) {\n                const p.yp, p.yn, p.zp, p.zn, x, xp, xn, dx2, dy2, dz2);\n            };\n            if (nx == 1) { point(0, 0, 0); continue; }\n            point(0, 1, 0);\n            #pragma omp simd\n            for Stable binding\n// keeps first-touch NUMA placement and per-core cache contents valid across steps.\nstatic int readTopo(const int cpu, const char* what) {\n    char path[128];\n    snprintf(path, sizeof(path), \"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu%d/topology/%s\", cpu, what);\n    FILE* f = fopen(path, \"r\");\n    if (!f) return -1;\n    int v = -1;\n    if (fscanf(f, \"%d\", &v) != 1) v = -1;\n    fclose(f);\n    return v;\n}\n\nvoid pinThreads() {\n    if (getenv(\"OMP_PROC_BIND\") || getenv(\"OMP_PLACES\")) return;\n    cpu_set_t mask;\n    CPU_ZERO(&mask);\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(mask), &mask) != 0) return;\n\n    struct Cpu { int id, pkg, core, smt, coreRank; };\n    std::vector<Cpu> cpus;\n    for (int c = 0; c < CPU_SETSIZE; ++c) {\n        if (CPU_ISSET(c, &mask)) cpus.push_back({c, readTopo(c, \"physical_package_id\"), readTopo(c, \"core_id\"), 0, 0});\n    }\n    if (cpus.size() < 2) return;\n    // SMT rank of each logical CPU within its physical core\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < cpus.size(); ++i)\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < i; ++j)\n            if (cpus[j].pkg == cpus[i].pkg && cpus[j].core == cpus[i].core && cpus[j].smt == cpus[i].smt) ++cpus[i].smt;\n    // Rank of each physical core within its package (among primary SMT threads)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < cpus.size(); ++i)\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < cpus.size(); ++j)\n            if (cpus[j].smt == 0 && cpus[j].pkg == cpus[i].pkg &&\n                (cpus[j].core < cpus[i].core || (cpus[j].core == cpus[i].core && cpus[j].id < cpus[i].id && cpus[i].smt == 0)))\n                ++cpus[i].coreRank;\n    std::stable_sort(cpus.begin(), cpus.end(), [](const Cpu& a, const Cpu& b) {\n        if (a.smt != b.smt) return a.smt < b.smt;\n        if (a.coreRank != b.coreRank) return a.coreRank < b.coreRank;\n        return a.pkg < b.pkg;\n    });\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const size_t t = static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_thread_num());\n        cpu_set_t one;\n        CPU_ZERO(&one);\n        CPU_SET(cpus[t % cpus.size()].id, &one);\n        sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(one), &one);\n    }\n}\n\n'''\ns=s.replace(anchor,pin+anchor,1)\ns=s.replace('''    // Allocate arrays\n''','''    // Bind threads before first touch so that data placement matches the compute phase\n    pinThreads();\n\n    // Allocate arrays\n''')\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\nmake -C /tmp/b 2>&1 | grep -E 'warning|error'; primary : all;\n        cpu_set_t one;\n        CPU_ZERO(&one);\n        CPU_SET(list[(t * list.size() / nt) % list.size()], &one);\n        sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(one), &one);\n    }\n}\n'''+s[s.index('\\n}\\n',b)+3:]\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\nsed -n '/^void pinThreads/,/^}/p' cahn_hilliard.cpp | tail -12; make -C /tmp/b 2>&1 | grep -E 'warning|error'; for t in 1 8 16 32 64 128 256; do echo T=$t; OMP_NUM_THREADS=$t /tmp/b/cahn_hilliard -x 256 -i 20 | grep time; done; /tmp/b/cahn_hilliard -x 512 -i 10 | grep time; /tmp/b/cahn_hilliard -x 256 -i 20 -r -v | grep -E 'Hash|PASS'"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":817,"cache_read_input_tokens":37713,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":817},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"7a5a2f10-bcb1-465f-b06c-f5b77659c79d","uuid":"30e684c8-4283-4cd8-beae-b4a9b56fb64d","timestamp":"2026-10-05T00:33:21.849Z","request_id":"req_011Cfi9dniKWEPkncojAEsWH"}

t < iterations; ++t) {\n            // Compute chemical potential\n            computeChemicalPotential(pold, pmu, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, \n                                    gamma, e_AA, e_BB, e_AB);\n            \n            // Update concentration\n            cahnHilliardUpdate(pnew, pold, pmu, nx, ny, nz, D, dt, dx, dy, dz);\n            \n            // Swap buffers (each thread swaps its private pointers; implicit barrier above)\n            std::swap(pold, pnew);\n        }\n        if (iterations % 2 != 0) std::swap(cold, cnew);\n    }\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"7a5a2f10-bcb1-465f-b06c-f5b77659c79d","uuid":"71581468-c944-4928-bbca-2f075948cbad","timestamp":"2026-10-05T00:33:37.750Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Pin OpenMP threads to CPUs (unless the user controls binding via OMP_PROC_BIND /\n// OMP_PLACES), like OMP_PROC_BIND=spread: threads with consecutive numbers (which own\n// neighboring slabs of the grid) go to topologically adjacent cores, using distinct\n// physical cores before SMT siblings. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfi9gYJyLS3VCQwSuVQgv","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The OpenMP version of `cahn-hilliard/cahn_hilliard.cpp` builds cleanly and gives bit-identical results to the original. The default 256-thread run on this machine (2-socket EPYC 7763, 128 cores, 256 hardware threads) takes **22 ms vs 2174 ms serial** at 256³ with 20 steps.\n\n**Correctness:** for the default case and six edge cases, the output `Sum` and `Hash` match the original exactly. The edge cases covered odd and zero step counts, non-cubic grids, dimensions of 1 or 2, and 3 threads. Validation passes.\n\n**Scaling** (256³, 20 steps, no OpenMP environment variables set):\n\n| Threads | 1 | 8 | 16 | 32 | 64 | 128 | 256 |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| ms | 1259 | 175 | 95 | 56 | 28 | 20 | 22 |\n\nAt 512³ (10 steps) it takes 335 ms.\n\n**What changed:**\n- **One parallel region for the whole time loop.** Both stencil sweeps split the (z, y) rows evenly across threads, and the implicit barriers keep the steps in order. Each thread swaps its own copy of the buffer pointers, and the vectors are swapped once at the end if the step count is odd.\n- **Inner loops rewritten for vectorization.** Neighbour-row pointers are computed once per row, and the boundary clamping only happens at the two x-edges, so the middle of the row is a plain loop the compiler can vectorize. The arithmetic is written in exactly the original order, which is why results stay bit-identical.\n- **Memory placement across the two sockets.** A small custom allocator stops `std::vector` from zero-filling memory on the main thread. Initialization then runs in parallel with the same work split as the compute loops, so each thread's data sits on its own socket's memory.\n- **Thread pinning.** Unpinned threads ran 10–20x slower here. With 128 threads each thread owns about 2 z-planes and reads 2 more from its neighbours, so neighbours on different sockets pass data between sockets every step. The code now pins threads with `sched_setaffinity` from glibc, which is not a new dependency. Neighbouring threads go on adjacent cores, and SMT siblings are only used when there are more threads than cores. This is skipped if the user sets `OMP_PROC_BIND` or `OMP_PLACES`.\n- **Validation** (NaN/Inf and min/max checks) runs in parallel.\n- **`CMakeLists.txt`** now requires OpenMP (`find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)`) and links it.\n\n**Things that differ from the original structure:**\n- `print_results` from the common header only accepts a plain `std::vector<double>`, so with `-r` the field is copied into one first. This happens after the timer stops.\n- The CPU topology is read from `/sys`, so the pinning is Linux-specific.\n\nThe executable name is still `cahn_hilliard`, and no files were added."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1039,"cache_read_input_tokens":42052,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1039},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"7a5a2f10-bcb1-465f-b06c-f5b77659c79d","uuid":"7cbbc5d1-ac14-4238-8fe1-b7490b831807","timestamp":"2026-10-05T00:33:47.899Z","request_id":"req_011Cfi9gXyNy4FmkMsdybrbf"}
